phases.name: Freeze the legal-analysis brief
phases.description: Preserve the live problem facts, separate requirements from assumptions, and make legal review and evidence boundaries explicit.

phases.name: Secure document intake and durable jobs
phases.description: Create the authenticated upload path, retain immutable document versions, and queue bounded asynchronous analysis.

phases.name: Extract and analyze contract evidence
phases.description: Parse formats and scans, preserve clause boundaries, and return version-pinned NLP results through a serving boundary.

phases.name: Add authorized semantic retrieval and audit
phases.description: Support cross-document search and comparison while keeping tenant, matter, jurisdiction, and document-version scope attached to evidence.

phases.description: Measure the stated targets on reviewed data, instrument the end-to-end pipeline, and leave unspecified legal and scale policies open.

steps.phase: Freeze the legal-analysis brief
steps.title: Read the exact live brief before choosing components
steps.content:
Live problem: Design an AI-Powered Legal Document Analysis Platform (ai_011; design-an-ai-powered-legal-document-analysis-platform). Category: AI - Legal Tech; domain: aiml; difficulty: Hard; estimated time: 60-90 minutes.

Description (verbatim): Design a platform that uses AI to analyze legal documents, extract clauses, identify risks, compare contracts, and provide natural language summaries for legal professionals.

Requirements (verbatim):
- Extract key clauses from contracts
- Identify non-standard and risky terms
- Compare multiple contract versions
- Generate natural language summaries
- Search across document repositories semantically
- Support regulatory compliance checks
- Handle due diligence document review
- Maintain audit trail of all analyses

Constraints (verbatim):
- Clause extraction accuracy above 95%
- Process 1000+ page documents under 2 minutes
- Support common document formats (PDF, DOCX, images)
- Handle legal terminology across jurisdictions
- Data confidentiality and access controls

Hints (verbatim):
- Fine-tune LLMs on legal corpora
- Use Named Entity Recognition for legal entities
- Implement document chunking preserving clause boundaries
- Use RAG for cross-document comparison
- Implement OCR pipeline for scanned documents
- Use attention visualization for clause highlighting

Companies listed for context only: Ironclad, Kira Systems, LegalSifter, Thomson Reuters. These names do not mandate vendors or establish product capabilities. The percentage and elapsed-time targets are requirements to validate, not demonstrated results. The brief does not specify traffic, jurisdiction coverage, retention period, supported clause taxonomy, or the measurement definition for extraction accuracy and processing time.

steps.phase: Freeze the legal-analysis brief
steps.title: Keep analysis evidence-linked and bounded
steps.content: Treat model output as review assistance, not legal advice or an autonomous decision. Return extracted text, clause labels, risk rationale, and links to source passages and document versions; show uncertainty and route low-confidence or unsupported jurisdictions to a human reviewer. Compare versions by aligned clause sections and retain both source versions. Use approved, versioned legal rule sources; their owners, jurisdictions, and update process must be selected with legal stakeholders. The brief does not establish those policies or guarantee a 95% result.

steps.phase: Secure document intake and durable jobs
steps.title: Add the legal-review workspace
steps.content: Provide upload, matter-scoped search, version comparison, review of cited clauses, and natural-language summaries. A React web app is an illustrative catalog choice, not a requirement from the brief.

component.label: Legal Review Workspace
component.description: Authenticated workspace for contract upload, review, comparison, and semantic search.

properties.purpose: Let authorized legal professionals upload documents, select a matter and jurisdiction, inspect clause-level evidence, compare versions, search permitted repositories, and review generated summaries.

component.highlightReason: The product needs an explicit user boundary for document review and evidence-backed results.

steps.phase: Secure document intake and durable jobs
steps.title: Validate and protect every request
steps.content: Terminate TLS, validate upload and search inputs, authenticate requests, and apply tenant-aware quotas. Do not invent request rates; establish them from product traffic and document sizes.

component.label: Authenticated API Gateway
component.description: Validates and routes workspace requests under an authenticated tenant context.

properties.purpose: Enforce TLS, input validation, OAuth 2.0 authentication, request-size limits, and tenant-aware rate limits before document or analysis APIs.

component.highlightReason: Confidential legal documents require an authenticated and validated entry point.

steps.phase: Secure document intake and durable jobs
steps.title: Route workspace actions through the protected API
steps.content: Send uploads, searches, and review actions over authenticated TLS; the gateway must derive tenant identity from verified credentials, never from a client-supplied tenant field alone.

connection.label: Authenticated HTTPS requests
connection.description: Workspace requests carry verified identity and matter context; authorization is enforced server-side.

steps.phase: Secure document intake and durable jobs
steps.title: Resolve user, tenant, and matter permissions
steps.content: Use organization identity and deny-by-default authorization for each document, matter, and jurisdictional rule set. MFA and the session-store choice below are suggested controls to confirm with the product's security policy.

component.label: Identity & Matter Authorization
component.description: Authenticates legal users and resolves tenant- and matter-scoped permissions.

properties.purpose: Validate organization identity and authorize every read, upload, comparison, and analysis against tenant, matter, and document ACLs; apply least privilege and record authorization context.

component.highlightReason: The confidentiality constraint applies to every access path, including retrieved passages and analysis results.

steps.phase: Secure document intake and durable jobs
steps.title: Check authorization before accessing matter data
steps.content: Resolve scopes before any document lookup or analysis; repeat authorization at the resource boundary to avoid treating gateway authentication as sufficient permission.

connection.label: Identity and ACL check
connection.description: Resolve user, tenant, matter, and document authorization before work is accepted.

steps.phase: Secure document intake and durable jobs
steps.title: Coordinate document and analysis workflows
steps.content: Keep request handling stateless: create document/version records, authorize access, issue durable analysis jobs, and return a job identifier. Do not perform a large OCR or model run inline with the upload request.

component.label: Document & Analysis API
component.description: Coordinates versioned document intake, asynchronous analysis, search, comparison, and result retrieval.

properties.purpose: Enforce resource authorization, create immutable document-version metadata, enqueue analysis and due-diligence jobs, expose status/results, and bind every result to source versions, jurisdiction, ruleset, and model version. Keep large-file processing off the request path.

component.highlightReason: A backend boundary is needed to coordinate secure uploads, comparison, search, and audit-ready analysis without blocking on long documents.

steps.phase: Secure document intake and durable jobs
steps.title: Send authorized operations to the application API
steps.content: Pass verified principal and request context to the API. The API still checks the requested matter and document ACLs before reads or writes.

connection.label: Authorized document API
connection.description: Routes validated upload, comparison, review, and search operations to the application boundary.

steps.phase: Secure document intake and durable jobs
steps.title: Retain source versions as immutable objects
steps.content: Store original uploads and derived artifacts under immutable version identifiers with checksums and encryption. S3 is the catalog's illustrative provider selection; the brief does not mandate a cloud vendor or residency model.

component.label: Encrypted Document & Artifact Store
component.description: Stores original versioned documents and generated text, page images, and evidence artifacts.

properties.purpose: Keep original PDFs, DOCX files, images, and derived OCR/text artifacts by tenant, matter, document, and immutable version ID; enable versioning, checksum validation, encryption, retention controls, and audited access.

component.highlightReason: Version comparison and audit require reproducible access to the exact original source and its derived evidence.

steps.phase: Secure document intake and durable jobs
steps.title: Persist each upload before scheduling analysis
steps.content: Validate file type and checksum, store the source immutably, and persist its version reference before publishing a job. Never put document bodies or signed URLs into general logs.

connection.label: Validated immutable upload
connection.description: Stores the original content and checksum under an access-controlled document version.

steps.phase: Secure document intake and durable jobs
steps.title: Make long-document processing durable and asynchronous
steps.content: Queue work by immutable document version and requested operation. Use bounded retries, idempotency keys, and visibility renewal; dead-letter exhausted jobs for inspection. Queue wait is included in the two-minute end-to-end measurement.

component.label: Durable Analysis Job Queue
component.description: Buffers OCR, extraction, comparison, and due-diligence jobs away from interactive API requests.

properties.purpose: Carry idempotent jobs keyed by tenant, document version, and operation; expose queue age and backlog, apply bounded exponential retries and dead-letter handling, and renew visibility for long work.

component.highlightReason: A durable asynchronous boundary protects uploads from long OCR and model work and makes backlog visible for the latency target.

steps.phase: Secure document intake and durable jobs
steps.title: Enqueue work only after the source version is durable
steps.content: The job envelope carries object/version IDs, operation, tenant and matter scope, jurisdiction, and an idempotency key; it contains no raw contract text.

connection.label: Version-scoped analysis job
connection.description: Schedules extraction, comparison, or due-diligence processing without copying confidential document bodies into the queue.

steps.phase: Secure document intake and durable jobs
steps.title: Parse PDF, DOCX, and image documents
steps.content: Use format-specific parsers and OCR for scans; preserve page, coordinates, headings, and clause boundaries. Fan out pages or sections with bounded concurrency, then reassemble deterministic document order. Capacity values must be benchmarked against representative 1000+ page files.

component.label: Document Parsing, OCR & Clause Chunking
component.description: Extracts text and layout from common formats and creates source-linked, clause-aware sections.

properties.purpose: Parse PDF and DOCX text; OCR scanned images and pages; preserve page coordinates, headings, tables, clause boundaries, language, and source offsets; emit deterministic chunks and confidence so review can jump to evidence. Apply bounded page-level parallelism and safe retries.

component.highlightReason: This worker covers the named formats and OCR hint while keeping expensive 1000+ page processing off the request path.

steps.phase: Secure document intake and durable jobs
steps.title: Scale workers from backlog without losing idempotency
steps.content: Workers claim durable jobs, renew leases when appropriate, and checkpoint page or section progress. A retry must not create duplicate analysis records or mix outputs from different document versions.

connection.label: Leased, idempotent jobs
connection.description: Dispatches bounded parsing and analysis work; autoscaling responds to queue age while tenant quotas prevent noisy-neighbor starvation.

steps.phase: Secure document intake and durable jobs
steps.title: Read the exact authorized source version
steps.content: Resolve a job's immutable object/version reference, re-check tenant and matter authorization, verify checksum, and keep derived OCR text protected under the same access scope.

connection.label: Authorized versioned source
connection.description: Provides the exact PDF, DOCX, or image version required by the job, with integrity and access checks.

steps.phase: Extract and analyze contract evidence
steps.title: Compose version-aware legal analysis steps
steps.content: Orchestrate entity recognition, clause classification, risk checks, version alignment, jurisdiction-aware retrieval, and cited summaries. Run the same pipeline for a single contract or a due-diligence batch; do not let retrieved documents cross authorization boundaries.

component.label: Evidence-Grounded Legal Analysis
component.description: Coordinates clause extraction, risk analysis, RAG retrieval, version comparison, and summary generation.

properties.purpose: Use clause-aware chunks and legal NER; retrieve only authorized, jurisdiction- and version-filtered evidence; compare aligned contract versions; evaluate checks against approved versioned rules; produce summaries with source citations, model/ruleset versions, and explicit uncertainty.
properties.steps: NER; clause extraction; risk and compliance checks; authorized RAG; version comparison; cited summary; confidence and human-review routing

component.highlightReason: An explicit orchestration boundary makes the required extraction, risk review, comparison, search, and summaries composable and auditable.

steps.phase: Extract and analyze contract evidence
steps.title: Pass source-linked sections, not detached text
steps.content: Each chunk retains document/version IDs, page and span offsets, clause boundaries, jurisdiction hints, OCR confidence, and access scope so every extracted result can be traced back to source.

connection.label: Versioned clause chunks and provenance
connection.description: Supplies normalized evidence with page spans, extraction confidence, and authorization metadata for analysis.

steps.phase: Extract and analyze contract evidence
steps.title: Keep inference behind a versioned serving boundary
steps.content: Serve pinned model versions with bounded concurrency, tenant-safe request handling, timeouts, and measured capacity. KServe is one catalog option, not a mandated platform.

component.label: Versioned Legal NLP Inference
component.description: Serves approved NLP model versions for clause, entity, and risk extraction.

properties.purpose: Expose pinned, evaluated model versions to the orchestrator; bound batch size and inference concurrency; return structured spans, labels, scores, and model version; fail closed or route to review on timeout or unsupported inputs.

component.highlightReason: Version-pinned serving enables repeatable audit and measured inference latency without making an accuracy claim.

steps.phase: Extract and analyze contract evidence
steps.title: Represent legal NLP as a replaceable model
steps.content: Use legal NER and clause-aware NLP to identify clauses, entities, deviations, and candidate risks. Fine-tuning on legal corpora is only appropriate when data rights, jurisdiction coverage, and held-out evaluation are established. Attention visualizations may aid inspection but are not proof of faithful reasoning; cite source spans instead.

component.label: Legal Clause & Risk NLP Model
component.description: Extracts contract clauses and entities and proposes non-standard or risky terms with evidence spans.

properties.purpose: Perform legal-entity recognition, clause extraction and classification, and candidate deviation/risk detection across the validated jurisdiction and clause taxonomy. Emit evidence spans and calibrated uncertainty; never assert a legal conclusion without review.

component.highlightReason: This model boundary covers extraction and risk identification while making the stated accuracy target something to measure, not assume.

steps.phase: Extract and analyze contract evidence
steps.title: Request structured clause and risk predictions
steps.content: Send bounded, authorized clause chunks and task type to the serving API. Avoid sending whole repositories when only selected spans are required.

connection.label: Authorized NLP inference request
connection.description: Requests entity, clause, and risk extraction for selected source-linked sections.

steps.phase: Extract and analyze contract evidence
steps.title: Load only an approved and evaluated model version
steps.content: Promotion pins an immutable artifact and evaluation report; each inference result records the exact model version so a later contract review can be reproduced.

connection.label: Pinned legal NLP model
connection.description: Serving loads the approved artifact and its jurisdiction/taxonomy evaluation metadata.

steps.phase: Extract and analyze contract evidence
steps.title: Return structured findings with uncertainty
steps.content: Return clause type, entity spans, candidate deviations, score/calibration metadata, source offsets, and model version. Low-confidence results remain explicitly uncertain and can be assigned for human review.

connection.label: Cited structured model output
connection.description: Returns versioned labels and evidence spans for checks, comparison, summaries, and review routing.

steps.phase: Add authorized semantic retrieval and audit
steps.title: Embed clause-aware text for semantic search
steps.content: Embed authorized chunks and query text using a model whose dimensions and legal-domain retrieval quality are evaluated together. The selected BGE model is an editable example, not a requirement.

component.label: Legal Text Embeddings
component.description: Creates embeddings for clause-aware contract chunks and semantic queries.

properties.purpose: Embed clause-preserving chunks and search queries; store model/version and dimension metadata; benchmark retrieval by jurisdiction, clause type, language, and authorized corpus scope.

component.highlightReason: Embeddings provide the semantic retrieval path for repositories and cross-document comparison.

steps.phase: Add authorized semantic retrieval and audit
steps.title: Index chunks with strict tenant and version filters
steps.content: Persist vectors with tenant, matter, document/version, jurisdiction, clause, and ACL metadata. Apply authorization filters before nearest-neighbor results are returned; test cross-tenant and revoked-access cases explicitly.

component.label: ACL-Filtered Contract Search Index
component.description: Stores clause embeddings with metadata for authorized semantic search and RAG.

properties.purpose: Index versioned clause embeddings and source metadata; require tenant/matter/document ACL prefilters, support jurisdiction and version filters, and re-check access before returning passages. Treat index contents as sensitive derived data.

component.highlightReason: Semantic search and RAG must preserve repository authorization and return passages tied to exact source versions.

steps.phase: Add authorized semantic retrieval and audit
steps.title: Embed only authorized clauses and queries
steps.content: Bind each embedding request to its source version and ACL metadata; query embeddings use the requesting user's authorized tenant and matter scope.

connection.label: Authorized clause/query embedding
connection.description: Generates vectors for scoped source chunks and semantic search queries.

steps.phase: Add authorized semantic retrieval and audit
steps.title: Store vectors beside source and access metadata
steps.content: Write vector, embedding-model version, source offsets, document version, and authorization dimensions as one consistent index record; make reindexing idempotent.

connection.label: Versioned clause vectors and ACL metadata
connection.description: Indexes legal text representations without losing their source version, jurisdiction, or authorization filters.

steps.phase: Add authorized semantic retrieval and audit
steps.title: Retrieve cross-document evidence before summarizing
steps.content: Retrieve only authorized passages filtered by matter, jurisdiction, document version, and requested comparison scope. Cite each passage in the answer and distinguish retrieved evidence from model-generated synthesis.

connection.label: Authorized, cited RAG passages
connection.description: Returns scoped evidence for semantic search, regulatory checks, contract comparison, and grounded summaries.

steps.phase: Add authorized semantic retrieval and audit
steps.title: Persist versioned analysis metadata and audit events
steps.content: Keep document/version metadata, ACL references, job states, extracted clause records, findings, result pointers, model/ruleset versions, and append-only audit events. Avoid storing unnecessary duplicate raw document text in relational records.

component.label: Document Metadata, Findings & Audit Store
component.description: Stores access-controlled document versions, analysis state, findings, and reproducible audit references.

properties.purpose: Persist tenant/matter ACL references, immutable document-version metadata, job state, extracted finding references, jurisdiction/ruleset and model versions, and append-only who/what/when audit events. Encrypt sensitive fields, retain according to policy, and support point-in-time recovery.
properties.encryption: Encrypt at rest and in transit; protect keys separately
properties.auditLog: Append-only access and analysis events with source/model/ruleset versions

component.highlightReason: The audit requirement needs durable, queryable provenance for every analysis without confusing metadata with original document storage.

steps.phase: Add authorized semantic retrieval and audit
steps.title: Record every accepted operation and its provenance
steps.content: Persist the actor, tenant/matter, source versions, operation, timestamps, job/result IDs, authorization decision, model and ruleset versions, and evidence references. Use idempotent writes and preserve an append-only event history.

connection.label: Versioned metadata and audit events
connection.description: Durably records upload, analysis, comparison, access, and result provenance for later review.

steps.phase: Add authorized semantic retrieval and audit
steps.title: Return a reproducible result to the application boundary
steps.content: Return structured findings and source references, not unsupported free-form conclusions. The backend persists the result and audit event before exposing it to the workspace.

connection.label: Cited findings and summary
connection.description: Returns version-bound clause results, comparison deltas, confidence, and review status for durable recording.

steps.phase: Add authorized semantic retrieval and audit
steps.title: Present summaries with source-linked clauses
steps.content: Show summary, clause classification, risk rationale, side-by-side version differences, jurisdiction and rule references, confidence, and source page/span links. Clearly label pending, incomplete, unsupported, or human-review-required results.

connection.label: Audited analysis and review results
connection.description: Returns only persisted results the current principal may access, with citations and review status.

steps.phase: Validate quality, latency, and operations
steps.title: Evaluate extraction accuracy on reviewed legal data
steps.content: Build a counsel-reviewed, rights-cleared evaluation set stratified by clause type, jurisdiction, format, and document length. Report the metric definition and confidence interval; do not ship a blanket >95% claim from an aggregate score if a critical subgroup fails. Fine-tuning and promotion remain separate gated decisions.

component.label: Legal Model Evaluation & Tuning
component.description: Evaluates candidate legal NLP models against reviewed, stratified examples before promotion.

properties.purpose: Maintain a rights-cleared legal corpus and reviewer-labeled holdout set; define clause extraction accuracy precisely; measure results by clause class, jurisdiction, language, and format; compare candidate fine-tunes and block promotion when the required threshold or subgroup safety criteria fail.

component.highlightReason: The >95% constraint is an empirical release gate and cannot be guaranteed by selecting an NLP model.

steps.phase: Validate quality, latency, and operations
steps.title: Promote only evaluated, immutable model artifacts
steps.content: Candidate models flow through a documented evaluation and approval gate; serving pins the exact approved artifact and its jurisdiction-specific evaluation report.

connection.label: Reviewed model candidate and evaluation
connection.description: Publishes an immutable candidate only after accuracy and subgroup release criteria are met.

steps.phase: Validate quality, latency, and operations
steps.title: Measure end-to-end processing and model behavior
steps.content: Measure upload acceptance to review-ready completion for representative 1000+ page files, including queue wait, OCR, inference, persistence, and retrieval. Track failures, retries, backlog age, per-format latency, confidence and drift. Production accuracy monitoring needs reviewed labels; do not infer accuracy from model confidence alone.

component.label: Analysis SLO & Quality Monitoring
component.description: Tracks document pipeline latency, failures, queue health, and reviewed model-quality signals.

properties.purpose: Measure end-to-end review-ready latency and stage breakdown by document page count and format; alert on the two-minute target, queue age, retries, OCR failures, and model-serving errors; report accuracy only from reviewed labels stratified by jurisdiction and clause type.

component.highlightReason: The 95% and two-minute constraints need reproducible measurements, visible failures, and explicit release/operations gates.

steps.phase: Validate quality, latency, and operations
steps.title: Instrument accepted jobs through user-visible completion
steps.content: Correlate request and job IDs without logging contract text, secrets, or signed object URLs. Define whether the two-minute clock ends at machine completion or human-review-ready output with product and legal stakeholders.

connection.label: Redacted request and completion metrics
connection.description: Measures end-to-end job lifecycle and API errors without placing sensitive document content in telemetry.

steps.phase: Validate quality, latency, and operations
steps.title: Expose parser and queue bottlenecks
steps.content: Report page throughput, OCR confidence/failures, chunk counts, retries, queue age, and per-stage elapsed time so the 1000+ page requirement is tested end to end rather than inferred from worker concurrency.

connection.label: Redacted parser and throughput metrics
connection.description: Provides stage-level timing and failure measurements for supported formats and large documents.

steps.phase: Validate quality, latency, and operations
steps.title: Track inference latency and reviewed quality separately
steps.content: Record model version, latency, errors, and aggregate confidence without retaining prompts or raw contract text. Join quality metrics only to appropriately reviewed labels and report jurisdiction/class coverage.

connection.label: Model version and redacted inference metrics
connection.description: Supports latency/error observability and separately governed, label-based quality evaluation.

steps.phase: Validate quality, latency, and operations
steps.title: Review the architecture against the frozen brief
steps.content: The graph covers clause extraction, risky-term review, version comparison, cited summaries, ACL-filtered semantic search, jurisdiction-aware compliance checks, due-diligence jobs, and durable audit provenance. Before implementation, agree on jurisdiction/rule sources, supported languages and clause taxonomy, the accuracy metric and holdout set, the exact two-minute completion boundary, retention/residency, and representative peak traffic. The React, S3, PostgreSQL, BGE, pgvector, Haystack, KServe, and Prometheus/Grafana values are replaceable catalog examples, not facts from the brief.
